item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem:
Meera's grandmother in Jaipur explains how people long ago kept time by watching the sky. Meera lists three time units: a day, a lunar month, and a year.

Which row correctly matches each time unit to the sky cycle that defines it?

options.A: Day – Earth's revolution around the Sun; lunar month – Moon's phase cycle; year – Sun's apparent daily cycle
options.B: Day – Sun's apparent daily cycle across the sky; lunar month – Moon's complete phase cycle of about 29.5 days; year – Earth's revolution around the Sun of about 365.25 days
options.C: Day – Moon's phase cycle; lunar month – Sun's apparent daily cycle; year – Earth's revolution around the Sun
options.D: Day – Sun's apparent daily cycle; lunar month – Earth's revolution around the Sun; year – Moon's phase cycle
